theater: 河南滑臺至瓜步沿黃河江淮

battle.name: 宋文帝攻魏河南之戰
battle.theater: 河南滑臺至瓜步沿黃河江淮
battle.brief: 景平二年正月，宋文帝劉義隆乘北魏太武帝平定北方之機，再發大軍北伐河南，以王玄謨為前鋒，屯軍滑臺，與魏騎隔黃河相持；糧道不繼而全軍潰敗，魏軍乘勝據滑臺、圍鍾離，進抵瓜步逼近建康。兩軍步卒仍以短柄長刃鐵鏃之長矛為骨幹，魏騎則靠襲擾糧道定勝負。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 交戰的一方是劉宋，即元嘉年間的南朝宋廷：宋文帝劉義隆坐鎮建康，以尚書令、中書令與各州刺史構成的文武體制調度四方。北伐主力由前將軍王玄謨領徐州、兗州兵馬北上，豫州刺史劉義宣自廣陵一線率眾接應，徐州刺史臧質屯兵鍾離策應，南徐州刺史檀道濟坐鎮京口、盱眙一線，掌南徐州部曲與東段防務，並參與籌劃江防。另一方是北魏，太武帝拓跋燾自平城出兵，兵分兩路：冠軍將軍拓跋仁率騎兵屯守黃河南岸，拒宋軍渡河並襲擾其側後；太武帝親率中軍主力南下，據滑臺、圍鍾離，最後進抵瓜步，與建康隔江相望。魏軍騎兵來自平城、代北邊鎮與并州，步卒以漢人軍戶為主，並有北方部族武裝與降附之眾參戰；宋軍除南府禁軍與各州郡兵外，還有由北歸流民、降卒編成的營伍。雙方都沒有成建制的舟師，江防全靠沿岸烽燧、弩樓與檻車，因此這是一場以黃河與淮河流域為主軸的陸戰。
countriesEn: One belligerent was Liu Song, the southern court of the Song dynasty in the Yuanjia era: Emperor Wen Liu Yilong sat in Jiankang, and the war effort was directed through a civil-military structure built around the Director of the Secretariat, the Master of Writing, and the provincial governors. The main northern column was led by General-in-Chief Wang Xuanmo with troops from Xu and Yan prefectures; the Inspector of Yu, Liu Yixuan, moved north from the Guangling area with a separate host to link up; the Inspector of Xu, Zang Zhi, garrisoned Zhongli as the covering force; and the Inspector of Southern Xu, Tan Daoji, held the Jingling-Xuyi line with the Southern Xu district troops, guarding the eastern approach and taking part in planning the river defence. The other belligerent was Northern Wei, from which Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao marched out of Pingcheng with the army split in two: Champion General Tuoba Ren held the south bank of the Yellow River with cavalry, refusing Song ferries and raiding the Song rear; Taiwu himself led the central host south, seized Sulan, invested Zhongli, and finally reached Guabu, where he stood across the river from Jiankang. Wei cavalry came from Pingcheng, the northern frontier garrisons and Bingzhou, while Wei infantry was largely drawn from Han military households, joined by troops of northern tribal groups and by those who had surrendered. The Song field army combined the Southern Palace guards and the provincial and county levies with units formed from defectors and refugees who had moved back south. Neither side fielded an organised river fleet; the river defence rested entirely on beacon towers, crossbow platforms and wheeled barricades, which made this a land war fought along the Yellow and Huai river corridors.
people: 宋文帝劉義隆是這場戰爭的策動者。第一次北伐慘敗、魏軍直抵瓜步之後，他仍執意再舉，景平二年正月下詔大舉，企圖用第二次出征雪恥並收復河南。前將軍王玄謨是河南方向的主攻統帥，他屯兵滑臺，渡河未成而糧道告急，北魏又遣使勸降其麾下將士，人心浮動，王玄謨最終放棄陣地、全軍潰退，宋文帝隨即貶其官職，此役之後他聲名再受重創。豫州刺史劉義宣是宗室重臣，奉命率眾北上接應北伐大軍，握有重兵卻與中央貌合神離，北伐的失敗加深了他的自疑與不滿，其後以清君側為名舉兵，兵敗被誅。徐州刺史臧質守鍾離，拒魏軍攻擊數月，兵精城固，與索暢、宗悫等將領一同守禦淮北，屢挫魏軍攻勢。魏方主帥太武帝拓跋燾親自統兵南下，以拓跋仁為前鋒拒守河岸，自己率主力在滑臺、鍾離、瓜步之間指揮攻勢，直抵長江邊，最後因糧秣、疫病與北方邊患而回師；瓜步對峙期間，宋廷遣使與魏軍交書，力陳勞師遠征之弊，魏軍遂連夜退走。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen Liu Yilong was the man who set this war in motion. Even after the first northern expedition had collapsed and Wei cavalry had reached Guabu, he insisted on a second attempt, issuing the general order in the first month of the Jingping second year in order to wipe out the shame and recover Henan. General-in-Chief Wang Xuanmo commanded the main thrust in the Henan direction. He entrenched at Sulan, failed to force a crossing, and then found his supply line failing while Wei emissaries worked on his officers; when morale broke, he finally abandoned his position and the whole army disintegrated, and the emperor promptly stripped him of his offices, a blow to his reputation that followed him for the rest of his career. Liu Yixuan, Inspector of Yu and a prince of the blood, was ordered to bring his host north to support the expedition; he held great armies while his loyalty to the centre was nominal at best, and the collapse of the campaign deepened his resentment. He later rose in revolt under the banner of clearing the court of the regicide and was executed when his rising failed. Zang Zhi, Inspector of Xu, held Zhongli against the Wei besiegers for months with disciplined troops and a strong wall, working with commanders such as Su Chang and Zong Qian to defend Huai River country and repeatedly repulses Wei attacks. On the Wei side, Emperor Taiwu Tuoba Tao led the campaign in person, using Tuoba Ren as his forward guard on the river and directing the main body himself across Sulan, Zhongli and Guabu, pushing to the edge of the Yangtze before withdrawing because of supplies, disease and trouble in the north. During the standoff at Guabu the Song court exchanged letters with the Wei army, pressing the point that a long march to distant country exhausted any army, and the Wei withdrew in the night.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是亞述長矛：一柄短柄、長刃、配著鐵鏃的刺槍，公元前九世紀已在兩河流域的城牆下使用，亞述人把它與弓和鐵器捆綁在同一套裝備裡，逐步攻下兩河的城市。兩千多年過去，到公元四五二年的中原，這種形制並未被淘汰：劉宋與北魏的步兵都仍以長矛為骨幹兵器，列陣時前置持矛、兩翼持盾，後排拋射弓箭與強弩，矛手在接戰前用長柄兵器列成密集橫隊，用以抵抗騎兵的衝撞。城下的重裝步兵披札甲、執大盾，束革與漆面盾牌是常備之物，卻非人人有之。卡上這柄亞述長矛的形制更接近南方鄉兵與屯田軍使用的短柄矛，而非北魏騎兵使用的長騎槍：魏軍騎兵在馬上多用長杆的槍與馬刀，重心高、衝擊強，步軍要靠密集的矛陣加上拒馬、鹿角，才能削弱其衝力。兵器之外，攻城一方使用撞車、雲梯、巢車與投石機，車頂覆土袋以抵禦箭矢，牆上的守軍以弩、落石、木椎與火攻反制；守城一方備有檻車、拒馬、千斤弩等器具，用來遮斷道路與封閉缺口。糧秣的運輸同樣靠器械：宋軍沿淮河與運河由船隊北運，魏軍則自河北沿黃河與陸路輸送，兩條補給線的長度，實際決定了誰能在河南站得住。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Assyrian spear: a short-hafted, long-bladed thrusting spear with an iron socketed head, used against the walls of Mesopotamian cities from the ninth century BC, when the Assyrians bound it together with the bow and iron gear in a single equipment load and took city after city downriver. Some two millennia later, in the Central Plains of AD 452, the pattern had not been retired: the infantry of both Liu Song and Northern Wei still built their line on the spear, with spearpoints in front, shields on the flanks, and archers and strong crossbowmen behind, while the spearmen formed dense ranks before contact so as to absorb the charge of cavalry. The armoured infantry of the walls carried lamellar armour and large shields; leather and lacquered shields were standard equipment but not universal. The Assyrian spear on the card matches the short-hafted spears of the southern levies and garrison troops rather than the long cavalry lances of the Wei horse: Wei riders fought with long-shafted lances and sabres from the saddle, high of centre and heavy on impact, so the foot had to blunt that shock with a close-packed spear wall backed by caltrops and sharpened stakes. Beyond the hand weapons, the besiegers brought battering rams, siege ladders, turreted carts and stone-throwers, the carts roofed with sacks of earth to shrug off arrows, while the defenders answered with crossbows, dropped stones, wooden logs and fire; the defenders also kept wheeled barricades, anti-horse stakes and heavy crossbows to cut the roads and seal the breaches. Supply was an instrument too: the Song fed its army north by river fleet along the Huai and the canal system, the Wei moved its provisions from Hebei by the Yellow River and overland roads, and the length of those two lines decided who could hold Henan for long.
tactics: 戰術層面上，這是一場典型的河岸攻守與補給消耗。宋軍的計畫是重演上一次北伐的路線：主力自彭城、泗口一線北上，先在黃河南岸滑臺一帶立營，收集渡河器具，把裝甲、攻城器械與糧車用船筏連成浮橋，試圖強渡黃河直取洛陽、豫州諸郡。魏軍的對策簡單而有效：拓跋仁率騎兵屯在河岸，不與宋軍正面爭鋒，只以小隊襲擾其營壘、燒毀糧車，牢牢守住渡口，使宋軍屯兵日久而糧道不繼。魏軍更利用騎兵速度切斷宋軍與建康之間的連絡，截奪運糧車隊，使宋軍在黃河南岸進退失據；王玄謨放棄滑臺時，隊伍已失去縱隊與行列，前鋒一亂，全軍即告崩潰，追擊的魏騎在黃河灘塗上擴大戰果。北伐敗後，魏軍轉取攻勢：以大軍包圍鍾離，先築長壘斷絕城中樵汲與糧道，再造撞車、雲梯、投石機輪番攻城，四面環攻，卻因城堅、弩石猛烈而屢攻不克，攻城器械的損耗反成拖累。最後魏軍主力南下至瓜步，江防隨之緊張：宋廷在石頭城與建康北岸佈置弩樓、檻車與烽燧，處處舉火，魏軍遠望江上火把相連，誤判援軍已至，終究不敢輕渡，轉而連營西撤。兩軍都靠騎兵與夜色掩護機動，也都靠糧秣決定能撐多久。
tacticsEn: Tactically this was a textbook contest of riverbank attack and defence decided by supply. The Song plan was to repeat the route of the previous expedition: the main column would move north from Pengcheng and Sikou, establish its camps on the south bank of the Yellow River around Sulan, gather crossing equipment, and lash armour, siege machines and baggage wagons onto rafts to form a floating bridge in order to force the river and strike at Luoyang and the prefectures of Yu. The Wei answer was simple and effective. Tuoba Ren held the bank with cavalry, declined to trade blows with the Song main body, and instead sent small detachments to harass the camps and burn baggage wagons, keeping the fords firmly closed so that the Song army sat before the river while its supply line withered. Wei horsemen used their speed to cut the Song communications with Jiankang and intercept the baggage convoys, leaving the army stranded on the south bank with nowhere to advance and no way back. When Wang Xuanmo gave up Sulan his formations had already lost cohesion and order; once the vanguard broke, the whole army came apart, and the pursuing Wei horse spread the disaster along the Yellow River flats. After the expedition failed the Wei went over to the offensive, surrounding Zhongli with the main host, building long circumvallations to cut the town off from fuel and food, then working battering rams, ladders and stone-throwers against it in turn. The four-sided siege made no headway against a strong wall and heavy crossbow and stone fire, and the loss of siege equipment became a drag on the army itself. Finally the Wei main body marched down to Guabu and the river defence was thrown into a ferment: the Song placed crossbow platforms, wheeled barricades and beacon fires along the Stone City and the north bank of Jiankang, and the fires were lit along the whole line. Seeing torches apparently connected along the river, the Wei assumed reinforcements had arrived, refused to attempt a crossing, and struck camp westward. On both sides cavalry and the cover of night carried the manoeuvres, and on both sides the length of the rations decided how long anything could last.
data: 可核對的數字並不多，以下只列比較有根據的幾組。首先是時間：景平二年正月下詔出兵，王玄謨在黃河南岸屯兵到夏初才潰退，前後約三個月；同年十月魏軍主力抵達鍾離城下，圍城直到次年正月才解，歷時近四個月；十一月魏軍進抵瓜步，停留約五十日，至十二月方才班師。其次是距離：建康至滑臺的路程約近二千里，水路與陸路並行；瓜步距建康城不過數十里，一夜之間即可傳警，這是魏軍能直搗建康北岸的前提。兵力方面，兩史記載都極為夸張：魏軍南下常自稱眾數十萬，宋軍各路兵馬合計亦被寫成十餘萬乃至數十萬，但以南北兩朝當時能抽調的諸州兵馬推算，實際作戰兵力當在數萬至十餘萬之間，至於將領所部家屬與隨軍丁夫則更難核實。損失方面，第二次北伐宋軍前鋒幾乎全滅，退兵途中失散與被俘者以萬計，受損兵種以被徵發的郡縣丁壯與屯田兵為主；鍾離守軍只是數千人規模，卻頂住了數十萬大軍的圍攻。糧食是另一個關鍵數字：滑臺屯軍日耗糧以數千石計，黃河浮橋與淮河船隊的運輸量，才是整場戰役能撐多久的實際上限。
dataEn: The number of figures that can be checked is small, so only the better grounded groups are set out here. First, time. The general order was issued in the first month of the Jingping second year; Wang Xuanmo's army stood on the south bank of the Yellow River until it disintegrated in the early summer, roughly three months in all. In the tenth month of the same year the Wei main host stood beneath the walls of Zhongli, and the siege did not lift until the first month of the following year, close to four months. In the eleventh month the Wei reached Guabu, stayed some fifty days, and only in the twelfth month marched home. Second, distance. The road from Jiankang to Sulan ran close to two thousand li, part water and part land. Guabu lies only a few dozen li from the city of Jiankang, so the alarm could travel in a single night, which is what allowed the Wei to strike at the north bank of the capital. Third, strength. The historians of both courts are wildly inflated: the Wei host marching south is habitually called several hundred thousand, and the combined Song columns are written up as anywhere from a hundred thousand to several hundred thousand, but judging from the provincial forces the two courts could actually detach, the real order of battle must have been in the tens of thousands at most, with the households and camp followers of the commanders far harder to count. Fourth, losses. The Song vanguard was very nearly annihilated in the second expedition, and the men lost or captured while falling back were counted in myriads, the hardest hit being the county levies and garrison farmers conscripted into the ranks; the defenders of Zhongli were only a few thousand strong yet held off a host numbering tens of thousands. Food is the other crucial figure: the camp at Sulan consumed thousands of shi of grain a day, and the tonnage that the Yellow River rafts and the Huai River fleet could move was the real ceiling on how long the campaign could last.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是雪恥：元嘉二十七年第一次北伐，宋軍在磻磧、滑臺一線崩潰，王玄謨的部隊在黃河邊被魏騎追殺，檀道濟退兵時還要用唱籌量沙的欺敵之計才得脫身，魏軍隨後直抵瓜步，江北一度震動，宋廷顏面盡失，江南士論稱此為元嘉北伐的敗筆。宋文帝一直耿耿於懷，兩年後再舉，用的仍是王玄謨，仍是滑臺，仍是同一條北路。第二層是對形勢的判斷：北魏太武帝在平定蓋海、柔然之後，內部又有宗室相殘、誅除異己的風波，宋廷以為北朝內爭可乘，遂把出兵時機壓在景平二年年初。第三層是地盤與資源的誘惑：河南黃河以南的豫州、兗州，是北魏南面最富庶的農業區，也是劉宋人口與糧源最直接的補充；對一個偏安的南朝而言，奪回河南既是軍事目標，也是財政目標，況且劉宋開國以來便自認正統在南方，取北方乃雪國恥，不取便坐實偏安之譏。此外還有直接的人事導火線：北伐是宋文帝晚年最看重的軍事工程，主持者必須是他最信任的劉義宣與王玄謨，這一點既推動了出兵，也種下將來軍權與皇權之間的裂縫。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause behind the fighting. The surface one is the wiping away of a disgrace. In the Yuanjia twenty-seventh year the first northern expedition collapsed on the Panqi and Sulan line; Wang Xuanmo's troops were run down and killed by Wei cavalry at the Yellow River, and Tan Daoji could only break contact by the trick of singing tally sticks and measuring the sand. Wei cavalry then rode to Guabu, the area north of the river was shaken, and the Song court lost face completely, with southern literati calling the whole affair a stain on the Yuanjia record. Emperor Wen never let the point go, and two years later he marched again with the same commander, the same objective at Sulan, and the same northern road. The second layer is a reading of the situation: after Taiwu of Wei had settled the affairs of the steppe and of Rouran, there were further feuds among the imperial clan and purges of rival households in the north, and the Song court judged that the internal disorder of the northern dynasty could be exploited, so the moment for marching was pushed to the beginning of the Jingping second year. The third layer is the lure of territory and resources. Yu and Yan, the prefectures south of the Yellow River in Henan, were the most fertile agricultural districts on Wei's southern frontier and the most direct supplement to the population and grain of Liu Song. For a dynasty settled in the south, taking Henan back was both a military aim and a fiscal one, and the house of Liu had ever since its foundation claimed the orthodox succession lay in the south, so that reclaiming the north would answer the national humiliation while failing to do so confirmed the charge of mere partition. There is also a personal trigger: the northern expedition was the military work Emperor Wen valued most in his later years, and the only men he would trust to run it were Liu Yixuan and Wang Xuanmo, an arrangement that drove the war out and at the same time sowed the coming rift between military power and the throne.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接結果是劉宋第二次北伐落空，河南仍在北魏手中，而更深遠的後果落在南朝政治本身。劉義宣在北伐中握有重兵、居徐州豫州要地，兵力所聚、功勳歸於朝廷，名位卻在諸王之下，敗績之後朝廷的責罰與猜忌一齊落到他頭上，其後他以誅弒君者、清君側為名舉兵，兵敗被誅，宗室與將佐多人牽連其中。與此同時，主帥王玄謨罷官去職，一代名將就此廢置，直到劉義宣之亂平定後才重新出仕，此時已是暮年。宋文帝本人也在北伐反覆失敗的焦慮中於元嘉三十年二月被劉元劉弒殺，皇位轉入少帝與孝武帝之手，劉宋的內鬥由此全面爆發，北伐的失敗可說是南朝宋走向崩解的起點。北魏方面，太武帝的南下雖然未能在長江上架橋，卻把戰線推到了建康城下，證明北方騎兵配合攻城器械千里奔襲的可行性；他回師後再度北征柔然，卻在大敗中病死軍中，兩年之內連失兩位皇帝，北魏自己也走進短暫的混亂。長期來看，南北對峙的格局不變，兩朝在淮河與漢水之間的反覆拉鋸定型，後來的北伐與南宋、北魏的邊境戰，都沿用同一條北上的補給線與同一批渡河點。
impactEn: The immediate outcome of this war was that Liu Song's second northern expedition came to nothing, Henan remained in Wei hands, and the deeper consequences fell on southern politics itself. Liu Yixuan had held great armies and the key posts of Xu and Yu during the campaign; the troops were his but the credit for them went to the court, and his rank was below that of the other princes, so after the defeat the blame and the suspicion of the court fell on him together, and he later rose in revolt under the banner of punishing the regicide and clearing the court, was defeated and executed, and princes and commanders were drawn into the business with him. At the same time the commander Wang Xuanmo was dismissed, and a famous general of the age was set aside until the revolt of Liu Yixuan was settled, by which time he was an old man. Emperor Wen himself was killed by Liu Yuanliu in the second month of the Yuanjia thirtieth year, amid the anxiety of repeated failed campaigns, and the throne passed to the Minor Emperor and then to Emperor Xiaowu, so that the internal conflict of Liu Song broke out in full; the failure of the northern expeditions can reasonably be called the beginning of the end of the southern Song. On the Wei side, although Taiwu never got a bridge across the Yangtze, he carried the front to the walls of Jiankang and demonstrated the reach of northern horse and siege train on a thousand-li march; after turning back he campaigned against the Rouran once more and died of illness in the field after a crushing defeat, so that two emperors in two years were lost and Wei too fell into a short confusion. In the long run the balance between north and south did not change: the see-saw along the Huai and the Han settled into a fixed pattern, and later northern expeditions and the border wars of the following centuries would use the same supply road north and the same set of crossing points.
result: 點完：宋軍第二次北伐徹底失敗，王玄謨放棄滑臺、渡河不成，主力在黃河一線崩散，河南各郡無一克復；魏軍乘勝追擊，據有滑臺、逼至鍾離，圍城數月不克，攻城器械與糧秣大量耗損，最後進抵瓜步，長江以北百里之內戒嚴，兩岸烽火不絕，宋廷以石頭城、江北諸軍與弩檻佈防，硬是把魏軍擋在江那一邊。魏軍久攻不下，兼逢北方邊患、糧秣不繼與士卒疲病，遂焚攻城具、驮載軍械而還，無功而返。對宋方而言，成果只剩一個教訓：北方騎兵加上遠程攻城器械，可以在半年之內把戰線推到長江下游；對魏方而言，這一戰證明南方的長江防禦足以擋住一次大規模遠征，但不足以反擊。次年劉宋內亂、宗室相殘，兩朝在淮漢之間的拉鋸重新開始。
resultEn: When it was over, the second northern expedition of Liu Song had failed completely. Wang Xuanmo gave up Sulan, never forced a crossing, and the main body came apart along the Yellow River, so that not one commandery of Henan was recovered. The Wei pursued the advantage, took Sulan, pressed on to Zhongli and failed to take it after months of siege, wearing out great quantities of siege equipment and provisions, then advanced to Guabu, where the hundred li north of the Yangtze were put under martial law and beacon fires burned on both banks. The Song, with the Stone City, the armies north of the river and lines of crossbows and wheeled barricades, held the Wei on the far side of the water. The Wei had besieged without result, and with trouble in the north, failing supply and sick and exhausted troops, they burned their siege engines, loaded their military stores and marched home without a prize. For the Song the campaign left a single lesson: northern horse supported by long-range siege machinery could carry the front to the lower Yangtze within half a year. For the Wei it proved that the southern river defence could stop a large expedition but was in no position to answer it. The following year Liu Song fell into internal war and fratricide among the princes, and the see-saw between the two courts along the Huai and the Han began again.
